title: When the Drop Falls
author: Oscar Yarrow
blurb: Odile Voss, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
